summary: Navigates the user to another location.

alternatives.when: The element performs an on-page action rather than navigation.

pitfalls: Provide href for navigation even when onClick handles client-side routing, so Link renders an anchor rather than a button styled as a link.
If underline is set to never, ensure the surrounding context still makes the link identifiable.

examples.description: Allow keyboard users to bypass repeated navigation and move to the main content.
